description: This Java source file implements an immutable class ActorAskCacheLoader which provides asynchronous cache loading functionality by querying Akka actors or PubSub mediators. It supports multiple resource types and handles creating commands and transforming responses for cache entries.

classes.name: ActorAskCacheLoader
classes.description: Provides asynchronous cache loading by querying Akka actors or PubSub mediators, supporting multiple resource types with customizable command creation and response transformation.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Loads a cache entry asynchronously for a given key by sending an ask message to the appropriate actor, and processes the response into an Entry.

methods.name: getEntityRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the ActorRef for the given resource type.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a command message to request cache data based on resource type and entity ID.

methods.name: transformResponse
methods.description: Transforms a raw response object into a cache Entry based on resource type.
